newsitem.title: USA: Kemet CFO James Jerozal to retire.
newsitem.headline: Kemet CFO James Jerozal to retire.

text.p: KEMET Corp on Friday said chief financial officer and treasurer James Jerozal is planning to retire from the company "in the next few months."
The firm said the retirement is consistent with the company's ongoing review of its organizational structure and staffing requirements.
Kemet said D. Ray Cash will be promoted to Treasurer.
A company spokesman was unavailable to say what position Cash held previously, or if he would also be assuming Jerozal's role as chief financial officer.
